claims: Malik Willis signed a 3-year, $67.5 million contract with the Miami Dolphins in March 2026.
The contract features $45 million in total guarantees.
$45 million is fully guaranteed at signing.
The deal makes him the 21st-highest-paid QB.
Void years were added for cap flexibility.
His 2026 cap hit is roughly $5.67 million.
Contract structure is 3 years with 2 void years added (2029 void).
The void years spread the $22.5M signing bonus.
Miami can potentially move on from the contract after two seasons (2027).
Willis joined the Dolphins as a starter following the release of Tua Tagovailoa.
Willis served as a backup with the Green Bay Packers.
